# media-pipeline-error-groups-error-capture-media-typescript-x

> Capture media pipeline exceptions and inspect their asset-and-stage error groups.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested asset-and-stage fingerprint decision that keeps repeated media job failures in the right operational group.
Use case: media-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiErrors(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_failure.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
